part.name: Cross-rod clamp assembly (3-solid model)
part.description: Assembly-like single STEP containing three solids: a long diagonal tubular member, a long vertical member, and a central clamp/block that captures/locates the members. Geometry includes tubular bores, end interfaces, corner rounds/fillets, and multiple planar clamp faces for load distribution and constraint.
part.symmetry_note: Overall geometry is largely symmetric about the X=0 plane and Z=0 plane for the clamp body; the diagonal member is symmetric about its own axis; the vertical member is symmetric about X=0.

Section.name: Diagonal tubular member
features included: Primary outer tubular surface (OD)
Internal bore (ID) / tube hollow
End interfaces (annular end faces)
Local saddle/blend region where clamp engages the tube
Small through/spot holes near clamp region (pin/fastener/fixture holes)
Section.function intent: Acts as a spanning arm/member that is captured by the central clamp; provides a long lever/strut to transmit bending/axial loads into the clamp and to provide an interface for downstream attachment at the ends.
Section.physical behavior: Primarily carries bending and axial tension/compression along its axis; hollow section improves stiffness-to-weight. Local contact region at the clamp introduces bearing/contact stresses; blends/fillets reduce stress concentration at clamp engagement transitions.
Section.geometry: Long tube oriented diagonally in X-Z, with OD ~12.7 mm (radius 6.35) and an internal bore feature (inner cylindrical surface). Ends are cut by planar annular faces. Near the center are additional trimmed/patch surfaces (BSPLINE + smaller cylinders/planes) representing clamp engagement cutouts/clearances and local transitions.
Section.location: Spans across the model diagonally (X and Z extents), passing through/adjacent to the central clamp region around the global origin.

Section.name: Central clamp / block body
features included: Upper clamp pad/block (planar faces + corner rounds)
Lower clamp pad/block (planar faces + corner rounds)
Mid-neck/bridge region between pads
Central cylindrical boss/ring features around origin (likely fastener seat / reinforcement)
Outer side walls providing location and stiffness
Section.function intent: Joins the diagonal and vertical members at the crossing region, providing location, constraint, and load distribution; serves as the primary interface that constrains relative motion and spreads contact loads.
Section.physical behavior: Transfers load between members through bearing and frictional contact; planar pad faces provide broad contact to reduce pressure; rounded corners reduce stress risers; central boss/rings stiffen the clamp around the highly-loaded intersection and may provide fastening seating/clearance.
Section.geometry: Multi-tier clamp/block around the origin with top and bottom pads (y up to 27.94 and down to -15.24), intermediate planes at y=17.78/15.24/-2.54/-5.08, side planes at x=±25.4 and additional planes at x=±22.86, plus front/back planes at z=±25.4 and additional planes at z=±22.86. Numerous corner cylinders (radius 7.62) form rounded corners at both pad levels. Central cylindrical features include a main cylinder (radius 6.35) and ring-like cylinders (radius 9.525) with planar end faces at y=0 and y=12.7.
Section.location: Centered near the global origin; wraps around/near both members at the crossing region; extends modestly in X and Z compared to the long members and has the largest Y extent.
